name: Burn It Down! [Combat, Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
Burning torches and the discordant symphony of riotous singing ignite the fervor within your goblin allies.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +1, goblin.

Benefit(s): Whenever you make an attack with a torch, a flask of lamp oil fitted with a fuse, alchemist’s fire, a flaming weapon, or are while on fire, you grant a morale bonus on damage rolls to all goblin allies within 30 feet. This feat stacks with other instances of this feat to a maximum of +4. This bonus damage is fire damage.
